A [[Chevin pilgrim sect|sect]] consisting of members of the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]]<ref name="ARCH" /> [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Chevin}}</ref> possessed a '''sacred idol''' which had certain practices related to it<ref name="ARCH" /> by [[3646 BBY]].<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates/1|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Pilgrimage" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the two warring governments in the ongoing [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] had a companion of theirs follow the sect on a pilgrimage to a [[Unidentified blue sun|blue sun]] to learn their history. The Chevin welcomed the companion and at the end of the pilgrimage showed them into their [[Chevin pilgrim stronghold|stronghold]], where the sect instructed them in the idol's ways.<ref name="ARCH" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The sacred idol was mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "Pilgrimage" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="ARCH" />
